title: Do not let TLSRoute routers shadow TCPRoute routers
body:
### What does this PR do?

Keeps the TCPRoute routers that share their entry point and rule with a TLSRoute router.

### Motivation

Follow-up of #13946.
A TLSRoute router and a TCPRoute router never match the same connections, one being TLS and the other not, so neither shadows the other.

### More

- [x] Added/updated tests
- ~[ ] Added/updated documentation~

### Additional Notes
